# Step marker: a glowing tile outline 0.9 m (0.09 m band) and a chevron pointing -Y (the renderer's
# +Z at yaw 0). 0.08 m over the floor. Origin: on the floor at the tile's centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Glow --base-color 0.7098 0.8588 0.4000 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name N --size 1 --location 0.000 0.405 0.080
scale 0.900 0.090 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name S --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.405 0.080
scale 0.900 0.090 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name E --size 1 --location 0.405 0.000 0.080
scale 0.090 0.720 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name W --size 1 --location -0.405 0.000 0.080
scale 0.090 0.720 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name ArmR --size 1 --location -0.100 -0.020 0.080
scale 0.320 0.100 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
set rotation 0 0 40
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name ArmL --size 1 --location 0.100 -0.020 0.080
scale 0.320 0.100 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
set rotation 0 0 -40
apply --rotation
select all
shade flat
export marker.glb
